SEPTEMBER 26

Don't worry about the censor. He doesn't cut out anything important. All officers' mail is theoretically censored at the base censor's office or main post office. They pay particular attention to new outfits and those that are moving - others are not censored so closely. Hence many letters are not opened by them and many are, depending on the outfit. They keep their eyes on an outfit like this though, and as I have said before, a division is handled and handles itself entirely differently from a Service of Supply unit, a battalion or any separate unit. They get away with many things that a division cannot, and they likewise cannot do many things which we can.

Had another nice little jaunt today and saw more of this part of the country. Almost froze to death before returning but enjoyed the trip and got a few more supplies. The bicycles here are amazing and the riders even more so. Did I tell you about seeing a family the other day? A young boy about eleven headed the parade, followed by mother and dad on a tandem, with the baby in a side car. Young sister came pedaling up behind on small] bike. Everybody rides. They must put them on bikes as soon as they can walk.
